item.description:
• New SQL format: the toolbar Check button lints the whole file or the selection for syntax and risky statements (no WHERE, always-true conditions, AND in SET, INSERT column/value mismatch, missing semicolons…); click a result to jump to it
  • Themes replace editor color schemes: built-in Graphite, Paper, Night and Mist, plus any number of custom .theme files controlling colors and fonts of the sidebar, header, editor and preview; changes apply on save
  • Theme files show color swatches before each value; click one to pick a color, hover a key for its description
  • New files get the extension of the chosen format; dots inside names (e.g. "1.SmartPushWidget") are no longer treated as extensions
  • Fixed the editor occasionally appearing blank after launch or after creating a theme

• 新增 SQL 格式：工具栏「检查」对全文或选中语句做语法与上线风险检查（无 WHERE、恒真条件、SET 误用 AND、INSERT 列值数不一致、缺分号等），点击结果跳到对应行
  • 主题：设置中「编辑区配色」改为主题，内置石墨、纸张、夜航、雾蓝；可新建多份 .theme 自定义主题，配置侧边栏、顶栏、编辑区、预览的颜色与字体，保存即生效
  • 编辑主题文件时颜色值前显示色块，点击用取色器改色，悬停配置项显示说明
  • 新建文件时按所选格式补全后缀；名称中的点（如「1.SmartPushWidget」）不再被误认为后缀
  • 修复打开 App 或新建主题后编辑区偶尔空白
